items.titleZh: 墨西哥大奖赛最终练习赛发生的情况
items.summaryZh: 兰多·诺里斯和基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛最终练习赛中表现接近，而法拉利的速度在排位赛之前有所下降。
items.originalTitle: What happened in F1 Mexican GP final practice
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯和基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛最终练习赛中表现接近，而法拉利的速度在排位赛之前有所下降。
周五的领跑者查尔斯·勒克莱尔最终以第三名的成绩结束练习，但这是在软胎排位赛模拟尝试失败后。
勒克莱尔和队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿在FP3开始时交换了最快时间，就像他们的练习一样。
梅赛德斯是第一个切换到软胎的领跑者之一，乔治·罗素在考虑是否需要双准备圈，告诉车队考虑告诉安东内利在单圈热身之后加力，安东内利确实完成了两圈准备圈，并以1m17.601s的成绩成为最快。
那看起来将是本节练习赛的最佳时间，直到距离一小时练习赛结束还有两分钟时，诺里斯提升了成绩，比之前快了一千分之一，为麦克拉伦车队创造了新纪录。
勒克莱尔以0.117秒的差距排在第三位，这表明法拉利在排位赛中仍将是争夺杆位的竞争者，而奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在第四位结束本节练习赛，仅比他的领队队友慢两十分之一。
维斯塔潘在比赛后期抱怨刹车问题，以三又四分之一的十分之一秒的差距排在第五位，领先汉密尔顿， 法拉利 在第六位，差距不到七百分之一，而 小红牛 的两位车手再次都位于理论上的 Q3 分界线之内。
林德布拉德和第九快的劳森在中游对手中领先很多，尼科·胡肯伯格在奥迪车队落后四十分之一秒，排在阿尔皮纳车队双胞胎弗朗科·科拉皮托和皮埃尔·加斯利以及费尔南多·阿隆索的阿斯顿·马丁车队之前。
霍肯伯格在这次练习中（32圈）与Ryo Hirakawa并列创造了最高圈数，Hirakawa被紧急调换到第二辆哈斯赛车，在本周末的剩余时间里取代了奥康的位置。
Hirakawa完成了整个计划，包括很多单圈推力的机会，在结束了一个使用三套软胎的练习后，他最好的成绩是1分19.504秒，这使他排在第19位，比最佳成绩慢了1.904秒，比队友Ollie 贝尔曼慢了六十分之一秒。
本土车手Sergio Perez是两位未能设置成绩的车手之一，另一位是奥迪的博托莱托。
Perez只完成了一圈安装圈数后，就回到了凯迪拉克维修区，车队在排位赛之前选择了进行预防性的引擎更换。
他的队友瓦尔特里·博塔斯排在第20位，比领先者慢2.742秒，落后于平川0.838秒。
14 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+1.250秒
detailEn: Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli were near-inseparable in final practice for Formula 1's Mexican Grand Prix as Ferrari's pace faltered ahead of qualifying.
Friday pacesetter Charles Leclerc ultimately ended up third for Ferrari, but only at the end of the session following aborted attempts at his qualifying simulation on soft tyres.
He and team-mate Lewis Hamilton - whose session played out in a similar way - had traded fastest times at the beginning of FP3 as the top teams all chose to start the session on medium tyres.

Mercedes was among the first of the frontrunners to switch to softs and while George Russell pondered whether a double-prep lap was necessary, telling the team to consider telling Antonelli to push after a single warm-up lap, Antonelli did complete two prep laps and duly went fastest with a 1m17.601s.
That looked as though it would stand as the session's best time until Norris improved with two minutes left of the hour-long session, going one thousandth quicker for McLaren.

Leclerc was 0.117s back in third, suggesting the Ferrari will remain a contender for pole in qualifying, while Oscar Piastri ended the session within two tenths of his pacesetting McLaren team-mate in fourth.

Max Verstappen complained of brake issues late on and was three and a half tenths down in fifth ahead of Hamilton, with less than seven hundredths covering the Ferrari in sixth and Arvid Lindblad at the back of the top 10, as Racing Bulls again had both drivers inside the theoretical Q3 cutoff.

Lindblad and ninth-fastest Lawson were well clear of their midfield rivals, with Nico Hulkenberg four tenths further back for Audi ahead of Alpine duo Franco Colapinto and Pierre Gasly and Fernando Alonso's Aston Martin.

Hulkenberg set the joint-highest number of laps in the session (32) alongside Ryo Hirakawa, parachuted in to the second Haas seat for the remainder of the weekend with Esteban Ocon replaced ahead of FP3.

Hirakawa ran through a full programme including plenty of opportunities for single push laps, and by the end of a session where he used three sets of softs had a best time of 1m19.504s that left him 19th, 1.904s off the pace and inside six tenths of team-mate Ollie Bearman.
Home driver Sergio Perez was one of two drivers, alongside Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto, who failed to set a time.
Perez completed just one installation lap before returning to the Cadillac garage, where the team opted to make a precautionary engine change before qualifying.
His team-mate Valtteri Bottas was 20th, 2.742s off the pace and 0.838s behind Hirakawa.
14 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +1.250s

items.originalTitle: F1 Mexico GP: Lando Norris tops final practice by 0.001s from Kimi Antonelli
detailZh: F1墨西哥大奖赛：兰多·诺里斯以0.001秒的优势领跑最终练习赛
兰多·诺里斯在墨西哥大奖赛的紧张排位赛中险胜基米·安东内利
现世界冠军兰多·诺里斯在F1墨西哥大奖赛的第三场和最后一场练习赛中领跑，在赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道上，他与车手冠军基米·安东内利在紧张的比赛中的表现不相上下。
诺里斯的成绩仅比安东内利的初始基准低0.001秒，在复杂的超高海拔赛道上，所有四支顶级车队都处于竞争之中，其中一些车队的中场赛车遇到了动力单元问题。
一个平静的开局阶段，Ryo Hirakawa 在哈斯赛车中获得了很多曝光机会。在完成了第一节自由练习后，丰田车队支持的这位车手作为替补回到了哈斯车队，在墨西哥周末剩余的时间里代替了奥康。
奥康 因为一些尚未完全明朗的原因被车队停赛，这位法国人在第二节自由练习中与自己的赛车工程师发生了激烈的争执。
32岁的首秀车手Hirakawa 在困难且滑溜的高海拔阿特罗米奥·赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道上逐渐建立信心，而冠军热门安东内利 和 勒克莱尔 在练习赛的开局阶段展开了激烈的较量，因为所有的主要竞争者都在使用中性胎。
在第二节自由练习中因为引擎故障错过了宝贵的赛道时间后，汉密尔顿 在比赛进行到一半前以1分18.268秒的成绩脱颖而出，继续延续法拉利车队在周五的初始设置方向。
勒克莱尔再次从队友的圈速中夺走了一十分之一，随后汉密尔顿以1分18秒162的成绩领跑中胎轮胎的练习，勒克莱尔和安东内利紧随其后，而红牛和梅赛德斯车队看起来明显落后。
诺里斯换上软胎后，这位世界冠军车手以1分17秒873的成绩短暂领跑，领先队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和乔治·罗素，乔治·罗素对在福罗索尔赛车场入口处的复杂12号右弯缺乏抓地力表示遗憾。
勒克莱尔在艾塞斯弯道出现失误并减速后，安东内利以1分17秒601的成绩跃升至计时表首位，但在那之前，他对在1号弯被马克斯·维斯塔潘阻挡表示了不满。
安东内利在接下来的飞驰中在一号弯道出现失误，导致他在一号弯道的第一部分速度变慢，但最终并没有提高成绩。这为诺里斯创造了机会，他以仅慢0.001秒的优势超过了安东内利，以本周末最快的成绩进入排位赛。
勒克莱尔在第一区段迅速提升，但仍然保持在第三位，落后0.117秒，紧随其后的是皮亚斯蒂。维斯塔潘以0.351秒的差距排在第五位，他在刹车方面遇到了困难，这为2026年四支顶级车队之间的又一紧张排位赛奠定了基础。
第三区段的不整洁让汉密尔顿落后了超过四分之一秒，排在第六位，随后是拉塞尔和哈德贾，哈德贾称他的红牛赛车是“这周末我开过的最糟糕的赛车，太糟糕了”。
小红牛车队再次看起来在争夺最佳非顶级车队中很有优势，利亚姆·劳森在第九位超过了他的青训车队队友阿维德·林德布拉德，他们完成了前十名。
平川结束了他的练习，排在第19位，略领先于凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特里·博塔斯。奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔特莱托在出站圈时遇到了动力单元问题，引擎发出异常声音，冒出一股烟雾。
主场英雄塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯也未能完成一圈，凯迪拉克宣布在排位赛之前将进行一次“预防性引擎更换”。
detailEn: F1 Mexico GP: Lando Norris tops final practice by 0.001s from Kimi Antonelli
Lando Norris pips Kimi Antonelli ahead of a finely poised Formula 1 qualifying session at the Mexico GP

Reigning world champion Lando Norris has topped third and final practice at Formula 1's Mexico Grand Prix, beating championship leader Kimi Antonelli in a tight session at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez.
Norris dipped just 0.001s under Antonelli's initial benchmark as all four top teams looked in the mix on the tricky high-altitude circuit, with several midfield running into power unit trouble.

A quiet opening phase saw Ryo Hirakawa get a lot of airtime in the Haas. Having covered FP1, the Toyota-backed driver returned to the Haas as a substitute for Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the Mexico weekend.
Ocon was benched by the squad for reasons which are yet to be fully clarified, with the Frenchman having a heated exchange with his race engineer in FP2.

While 32-year-old debutant Hirakawa was building up confidence around the difficult and slippery, high-altitude Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, champion-elect Antonelli and Charles Leclerc traded blows during the opening stages of the session as all frontrunners were running medium tyres.

Having missed valuable track time in FP2 with engine trouble, Lewis Hamilton came to the fore just before the halfway mark with a 1m18.268s, picking up where Ferrari left off as the squad was satisfied with the initial set-up direction on Friday.

Leclerc took another tenth out of his team-mate's lap time, before Hamilton took top with a 1m18.162s lap to lead the medium-tyre runs that dominated the first half of practice, followed by Leclerc and Antonelli as both Red Bull and McLaren looked a clear step behind.

Bolting on softs, reigning world champion Norris briefly claimed top with a 1m17.873s ahead of team-mate Oscar Piastri and George Russell, who lamented a lack of grip through the tricky Turn 12 right-hander entering the Foro Sol stadium.

As Leclerc got out of shape through the Esses and backed out, Antonelli jumped to the top of the timesheets with a 1m17.601s lap, but not before voicing his frustration at Max Verstappen's impeding in Turn 1.

Antonelli then went purple in sector one on his next flyer but ultimately didn't improve. That opened the door for Norris to pip him by just 0.001s to head into qualifying with the fastest time of the weekend.

Leclerc found a late improvement with a rapid first sector but stayed in third, 0.117s behind, closely followed by Piastri. Verstappen was fifth, 0.351s behind as he struggled with his brakes, setting up another close qualifying session between 2026's four top teams.
An untidy third sector left Hamilton over four tenths adrift in sixth, followed by Russell and Hadjar, who called his Red Bull "the worst car I've driven this weekend, it's terrible".
Racing Bulls again looked well poised to win the best of the rest battle, with Liam Lawson pipping rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad to ninth as they rounded out the top 10.

Hirakawa ended his session in 19th, just ahead of Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas. Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto didn't manage to set a lap time after encountering a power unit issue on his out-lap, with a puff of smoke emanating from an ill-sounding engine.
Home hero Sergio Perez also failed to set a lap, with Cadillac announcing it would have to perform a "precautionary engine change" ahead of qualifying.

法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔在周五的两节练习赛中均排名第一，但迈凯伦和梅赛德斯亮出实力，以0.1秒的优势超过了这位摩纳哥车手。
安东内利很可能在周日的比赛中成为世界冠军，因为他只需进入前九名即可锁定一级方程式车手总冠军。

迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里位列第四，而红牛似乎已退出杆位争夺，马克斯·维斯塔潘落后领先圈速0.351秒，但周六晚9点（晚8点开始预热）的天空体育F1直播排位赛前，前排似乎确实有三支车队在争夺。
无论维斯塔潘在排位赛中表现如何，他都不能从杆位起步，因为他和小红牛车队的利亚姆·劳森因周五第二节练习中相撞而被罚退一个发车位。
赛会干事称该事件“不可接受”，两位车手都承认这次碰撞“没有必要且笨拙”。
在墨西哥城大奖赛第二节自由练习中，小红牛的利亚姆·劳森与红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘发生接触，这次碰撞最终导致两位车手都收到发车位罚单。
周六最后一节练习赛前又发生了更多戏剧性事件，哈斯车队做出令人震惊的决定，用替补车手平川亮替换埃斯特班·奥康，参加本周末剩余的比赛。
车队没有给出替换奥康的原因，但确认这位法国车手并未患病。
哈斯最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开车队，他在美国老板旗下的这支车队效力了两年，巴西年轻车手拉斐尔·卡马拉已签约作为他的替代者。
勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军平川亮在过去两年中多次参加哈斯车队的练习环节，在最后一次练习中排名第19，落后队友奥利弗·贝尔曼0.6秒。
埃斯特班·奥康通过车队无线电质疑哈斯车队在墨西哥城第二节练习中更改其运行计划的做法。

detailEn: Mexico City GP: Lando Norris pips Kimi Antonelli in final practice to set up thrilling Mexico qualifying

Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli were separated by just 0.001s at the top of the timesheet in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix; watch qualifying later at 9pm with Sunday's race at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm), live on Sky Sports F1

Sky Sports F1's David Croft and Karun Chandok discuss Esteban Ocon being replaced by Haas for the Mexico City GP, Liam Lawson and Max Verstappen being handed a grid penalty for their P2 collision and Isack Hajar's paddock altercation with a fan
McLaren's Lando Norris pipped Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli by 0.001s in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix to set up a thrilling qualifying.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc had topped both of Friday's practice sessions but McLaren and Mercedes showed their hand to outpace the Monegasque driver by one tenth of a second.
Antonelli is likely to become world champion in Sunday's race as he only needs a top-nine finish to secure the Formula 1 drivers' title.

McLaren's Oscar Piastri was fourth while Red Bull appear to be out of the pole position battle as Max Verstappen was 0.351s off the pace, but there seems to be a genuine three-team fight at the front for qualifying later on Saturday at 9pm (build-up from 8pm), live on Sky Sports F1.
Regardless of what he does in qualifying, Verstappen cannot start on pole position as he and Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson have a one-grid place penalty for colliding in second practice on Friday.
The stewards called the incident "unacceptable", with both drivers admitting the clash was "unnecessary and clumsy".
Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and Red Bull's Max Verstappen make contact during FP2 at the Mexico City GP - the clash would eventually lead to both drivers receiving a grid penalty
More drama took place before final practice on Saturday as Haas made the shock decision to replace Esteban Ocon with reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa for the remainder of the weekend.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad, with Brazilian youngster Rafael Camara signed as his replacement.
Hirakwa, a 24 Hours of Le Mans winner, has taken part in several practice sessions for Haas over the last two years and was 19th in final practice, six tenths down on team-mate Oliver Bearman.
